chunks.text: Today we will talk about Russia.
Russia is a very big, cold and historic country.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Russia?
Russia is in both Europe and Asia.
It is the largest country in the world.
It is next to many countries like China, Kazakhstan, Finland, Norway and Ukraine.
It touches the Arctic Ocean, the Pacific Ocean and the Black Sea.
What is the capital city of Russia?
The capital city is Moscow.
Moscow is a very big and busy city.
It has tall buildings, churches and the famous Red Square.
It is the center of politics, art and business.
Another big city is St.
Petersburg, known for its palaces, canals and museums.
How many people live in Russia?
About 145 million people live in Russia.
Most people live in the West, near Europe.
Russia has many cities, villages and natural areas.
What language do people speak in Russia?
People speak Russian.
Russian uses a different alphabet called the Cyrillic alphabet.
Some people also speak English, Tatar or other minority languages.
What is the weather like in Russia?
Russia is known for its cold winters.
Winter, very cold with snow and ice.
Summer, warm in the west, cool in the north.
Spring and autumn, short but beautiful.
In Siberia, it can be extremely cold in winter, sometimes below 40 degrees Celsius.
What does Russia look like?
Russia has mountains like the Ural Mountains, forests, rivers and lakes.
Tundra in the north and plains in the south.
The famous lake Baikal, the deepest lake in the world.
It is a country of many landscapes and natural wonders.
What animals live in Russia?
Russia has many wild animals such as bears, wolves and lynx, reindeer foxes and moose, tigers and leopards in the Far East, seals, whales and fish in the cold seas.
What do people eat in Russia?
Russian food is warm, hearty and perfect for cold weather.
People eat bread, potatoes and cabbage, meat, fish and chicken.
Soup, very popular in winter.
Dairy like sour cream and cheese.
Popular dishes, borscht, beet soup with sour cream pelmini.
Small dumplings with meat.
Blini, thin pancakes with jam or caviar.
Olivia salad, a cold salad with potatoes and mayonnaise.
What do people drink in Russia?
People drink water, tea and coffee.
Kvas, a traditional drink made from bread.
Fruit juice and milk.
Adults may drink vodka or beer.
Tea is often served in a glass with sugar or lemon.
What is life like in Russia?
Life in Russia is busy in cities and quiet in villages.
People enjoy spending time with family, going to the theater or ballet, walking in parks, celebrating holidays with food and music, reading books.
Russian literature is famous.
What are some holidays and traditions in Russia?
New Year's Eve, the most important celebration.
Orthodox Christmas, January 7th.
Victory Day, May 9th with parades.
Maslanica, a pancake weekend winter.
International Women's Day, March 8th.
People love to celebrate with flowers, gifts and music.
Some fun facts about Russia.
Russia has 11 time zones.
The Trans -Siberian Railway is the longest train line in the world.
The Russian flag is white, blue and red.
Lake Baikal is older than 25 million years.
The Matryoshka Doll is a famous Russian toy.
Now you know many things about Russia.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the snow, the culture and the food.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emili.
